name: Morgan Stanley
description: Morgan Stanley is a bank holding company with three segments. Institutional Securities (47 percent of segment revenue) advises and underwrites for corporations and trades equities, fixed income and commodities for institutions, earning fees and trading revenue. Wealth Management (45 percent) is the big fee machine: clients pay asset-management fees on about $2.75 trillion of fee-based assets, within $7.4 trillion of total client assets, plus net interest on $408 billion of deposits and $181 billion of loans. Investment Management (9 percent) runs mutual funds and alternatives for fees. Net revenues were $70.6 billion in 2025, up 14 percent, and it is one of the few large banks where wealth-management fees, not lending spread, are the core.

employees.note: Approximately 83 thousand employees across 42 countries (10-K, rounded as stated).

businessLines.name: Institutional Securities
businessLines.how: Earns advisory and underwriting fees from corporations and trading revenue from making markets in equities, fixed income and commodities for institutional clients, plus interest on lending and financing; revenues swing with deal and trading activity (up 18 percent in 2025).

operatingProfit.period: FY2025 (year ended 2025-12-31), segment income before provision for income taxes

businessLines.name: Wealth Management
businessLines.how: Advisory clients pay fees on a percentage of fee-based client assets (asset management $18,627M, 59 percent of segment revenue), plus commissions and transaction fees ($4,588M), net interest on deposits and loans ($7,911M); revenue rises with markets and client inflows.

operatingProfit.period: FY2025 (year ended 2025-12-31), segment income before provision for income taxes

businessLines.name: Investment Management
businessLines.how: Earns fees for managing investment assets on behalf of institutions and individuals; detail of products and fee types was not extracted.

operatingProfit.period: FY2025 (year ended 2025-12-31), segment income before provision for income taxes

geography.method: Regional revenue tagged in the filing's own XBRL instance: full-year contexts with one geographic dimension (or segments named after places), alone or crossed only with operating segments or a revenue line of the income statement; regions must add up to the revenue line within 1 percent; a member equal to the sum of others is a subtotal; the main split is the largest set of members adding up to the total; anything not broken out is a computed remainder.
